Name:           simple
Version:        1.0.0
Release:        1.fc42
Summary:        A simple test package
License:        MIT
URL:            https://example.com/simple
Source0:        https://example.com/simple/simple-1.0.0.tar.gz

%description
A simple test package with a single plain Source URL.

%prep
cd '/home/shebert/rpmbuild/BUILD/simple-1.0.0-build'
rm -rf 'simple-1.0.0'
/usr/lib/rpm/rpmuncompress -x 'tests/fixtures/specs/simple-1.0.0.tar.gz'
STATUS=$?
if [ $STATUS -ne 0 ]; then
  exit $STATUS
fi
cd 'simple-1.0.0'
/usr/bin/chmod -Rf a+rX,u+w,g-w,o-w .


%build

%install

%files

%changelog
* Mon Jan 01 2024 Test <test@example.com> - 1.0.0-1
- Initial package
